articles.title: Ceigall India's ₹330.84 Cr Delhi PWD Tender Cancelled
articles.description: Ceigall India Limited (CIL) has announced the cancellation of a tender by the Public Works Department, Government of Delhi, for which CIL was the L1 bidder with an aggregate bid cost of ₹330.84 Crores (including GST). The cancellation, communicated via email on August 17, 2026, is due to documentary considerations. This tender was for strengthening and other works of various roads under the South Maintenance Zone, PWD during 2026-27. The company has made this information available on its website.

articles.title: Bihar to resume mining after October 15, says CM Samrat Choudhary
articles.description: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary said the state is set to resume mining activities after October 15, with the tender process for 28 critical and strategic mineral blocks currently underway. He said more than 30 blocks are expected to be allotted by the end of September.
